headline: South Korea Third-Quarter GDP Expansion Beats Forecasts on Chip Export Growth
summary: South Korea's economy expanded at more than triple the expected pace in the third quarter of 2026. Growth was driven by robust global demand for semiconductors, according to Bank of Korea data.
why: South Korea is Asia's fourth-largest economy and a major global exporter of technology products, particularly memory chips.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Faster economic growth driven by chip exports supports fiscal revenues and trade balances.

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected GDP expansion buoyed investor sentiment around South Korea's technology supply chain and export outlook.
